decisions.rationale: In the title, 'ataxia-telangiectasia' is used adjectivally to modify the noun 'locus' ('an ataxia-telangiectasia locus'), similar to the 'colorectal cancer families' example, so it is a Modifier rather than a standalone disease.

decisions.rationale: In 'the gene for ataxia-telangiectasia group A', the disease name is the object of 'for' and refers to one specific disease (the group A form of ataxia-telangiectasia). It is not an adjectival modifier of 'gene', so it is a Specific Disease mention.
